programme.title: UEFA Women's Euro 2025 Final
programme.desc: England v Spain (Kick-off 5.00pm). All the action from the showpiece match, held at St Jakob-Park in Basel, Switzerland. England went into this tournament as the holders, having defeated Germany 2-1 after extra time on home soil three years ago thanks to substitute Chloe Kelly's winner, and they have had to work hard to reach this final, first finishing as runners-up to France in their group and then defeating Sweden on penalties in the quarter-finals, before prevailing 2-1 against Italy after extra time in the last four. Things are not expected to get any easier in this showpiece match, as Spain defeated England 1-0 in the 2023 FIFA World Cup final and comfortably topped their group before winning 2-0 against Switzerland in the last eight and also needing extra time in their semi-final to overcome Germany

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: 1970. Thriller. Directed by Sam Wanamaker. Stars George Peppard, Joan Collins & Judy Geeson. A British agent is determined to prove that a respected colleague is really a Soviet spy.

programme.title: Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: 2002. Drama/Comedy. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Fay Ripley, Helen McCrory & Ron Cook. In post-war London, a chance meeting between two old friends sets off a murderous chain of events.

programme.title: Beat Girl
programme.desc: 1960. Drama. Directed by Edmond T. Greville and starring Noelle Adam, Christopher Lee and Oliver Reed. Paul, a divorcee, marries a French lady but his daughter is determined to spoil the relationship.

programme.title: Bad Blood
programme.desc: 1981. Drama. Directed by Mike Newell. Starring Jack Thompson. Set in WW2, a New Zealand farmer who refuses to hand in his firearms and the siege that follows. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Look At Life Treading on the Gas
programme.desc: 1966. A captivating look at the methane gas ships that come from the Sahara desert.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Pigeons/Fishing for Next to Nothing. 1981. Jack Hargreaves goes pigeon shooting using decoys. He then heads to the river Kennet with some homemade equipment to sample fishing on a budget.

programme.title: Tinker
programme.desc: 1949. Documentary. Gunther Krampf tells the story of young mining trainees. Tinker (Derek Smith), a gypsy's son, runs away and joins the mining school.

programme.title: She's My Darling
programme.desc: 1937. Drama. Director: Syd Courtenay. Stars Peggy Simpson, Ian Fleming & Tod Slaughter. A story focusing on a woman's passion for an idle man and her marriage to his uncle, the family benefactor.

programme.title: Look At Life Jumping Jets...
programme.desc: 1965. A look at the new jet that can take off like a helicopter, with a focus on the people who evaluate it.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: 1945. Adventure. Directed by Rowland V. Lee. Stars Charles Laughton, Randolph Scott & Barbara Britton. Pirate, Captain William Kidd, tricks the king to hire him as an escort to a treasure ship.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Becomes a Banker. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, Charles Lane & Lester Matthews. Jed is hired as a bank vice president in order for him to participate in an interbank skeet shoot competition.

programme.title: The Naked Hills
programme.desc: 1956. Western. Directed by Josef Shaftel. Stars David Wayne, Keenan Wynn & James Barton. An Indiana farmer develops an insatiable thirst for gold and sets off to find fortune in California.

programme.title: Look At Life Blood and Fire
programme.desc: 1961. A look at the activities of the Salvation Army and how it has adjusted to the different needs of society.

programme.title: Worzel Gummidge
programme.desc: Very Good Worzel. 1980. Stars Jon Pertwee, Una Stubbs & Joan Sims. Mrs Bloomsbury-Barton has invited some important guests to lunch. Worzel and Aunt Sally are mistakenly hired to help for the day.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin's Nest. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Vito Scotti. The Penguin tries to get arrested as he wants to be sent back to prison so he can team up with a forger residing there.

programme.title: Pollyanna
programme.desc: 2002. Drama. Directed by Sarah Harding. Stars Amanda Burton, Tom Bell & Kenneth Cranham. Young orphan Pollyanna, bringing mirth and mayhem to her new home, goes to stay with her Aunt Polly.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Double Trouble. 1960. Stars Richard Greene, Alexander Gauge & Patricia Driscoll. When Friar Tuck's twin brother Edgar returns to Nottingham, the Deputy Sheriff attempts to use him to trap Robin.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Set a Murderer. 1954. Stars Honor Blackman, Martin Boddey, Clifford Evans. Two successful businessmen have a monopoly of the market in their particular field but suddenly a new competitor arrives.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Let's watch chock-a-block, then go shopping with famous faces in the 40s. A family go to Skegness after winning the pools in 1961, Noel's found an exciting advert and we watch a new Scopitone!

programme.title: A Hill in Korea
programme.desc: 1956. War. Directed by Julian Amyes. Stars George Baker, Stanley Baker & Michael Caine in his first credited film role. In the Korean war, British soldiers try to fight their way back to safety.

programme.title: Look At Life The Tower of Babble
programme.desc: 1962. A marvellous look at how the Post Office tower was built and what goes on inside it.

programme.title: Terror By Night
programme.desc: 1946. Crime Drama. Starring: Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce & Alan Mowbray. When a diamond is stolen on a train and the son of its owner is murdered, everybody is a suspect to Sherlock Holmes.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 35. 1976. It's the night of the working man's Oscars. We meet four of the 1976 winners - Cannon and Ball, Mark Channing, Paul Daniels and Pete Price.

programme.title: The Long Haul
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by Ken Hughes. Stars Victor Mature, Diana Dors & Patrick Allen. A former US serviceman moves to England after WWII but comes caught up in a dangerous smuggling ring.

programme.title: Budgie
programme.desc: The Man Outside. Stars: Adam Faith, Iain Cuthbertson & Lynn Dalby. Charlie Endell drives Budgie to a football match in his Rolls Royce. Just after they park, someone tries to shoot Charlie.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: The Alien Factor
programme.desc: 1978. A spaceship containing dangerous specimens crashes on earth near a small backwards town. Directed by Don Dohler, his first film.

programme.title: Resurrection of Zachary Wheeler
programme.desc: 1971. Sci-Fi starring Leslie Nielsen, Bradford Dillman and Don Haggerty. After a terrible car accident, a presidential candidate awakens in a New Mexico clinic without a trace of injury.

programme.title: Tell Me Another
programme.desc: 1976. No Particular Theme. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Arthur Askey, Bill Maynard and Barbara Windsor.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: The Accused. Directed by Aaron Spelling and starring Don Durant and Mark Goddard. Virgil Kincaid, the owner of a hardscrabble ranch, is accused of murdering Lorna Parrott.

programme.title: 13 East Street
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Robert Baker. Starring Patrick Holt, Dora Bryan & Michael Balfour. A detective poses as an escaped convict to catch a gang of warehouse robbers.

programme.title: Third Party Risk
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Directed by Daniel Birt. Stars Lloyd Bridges, Finlay Currie & Maureen Swanson. A man holidaying in Spain becomes inadvertently mixed up in a case of murder and microfilm smuggling.

programme.title: The Voice Of Merrill
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Starring Valerie Hobson, James Robertson Justice & Sam Kydd. A dying author frames a radio narrator for killing his secretary.

programme.title: The Big Trail
programme.desc: 1930. Western. Director: Raoul Walsh. Stars John Wayne, Marguerite Churchill, Tyrone Power. Sr. Breck Coleman agrees to lead pioneers trying to make their way on the treacherous Oregon Trail.

programme.title: An Inspector Calls
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Director: Guy Hamilton. Stars Alastair Sim, Olga Lindo, Eileen Moore. The Birling family are rich and complacent. It is 1912, and the impending war has yet to fall across their lives.

programme.title: Appointment with Venus
programme.desc: 1951. War. Director: Ralph Thomas. Stars: David Niven, Glynis Johns & George Coulouris. During WWII, a British Major is tasked with rescuing a pedigree cow from a German-occupied Channel Island.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Granny Versus the Weather Bureau. 1964. Stars Irene Ryan, John McGiver & Quinn O'Hara. Granny's old-fashioned ways of predicting the weather are pitted against the Weather Bureau's technology.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. The Tyburn Case. Director: David Paltenghi. Stars John Warwick, Patricia Marmont and Howard Marion Crawford. Supt. Reynolds suspects a lawyer drowned a widow for the insurance money. (S1, E24)

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Escape to Ponderosa. 1960. Stars Lorne Greene, Gloria Talbott & Joe Maross. The Cartwright's rally together after Adam is taken hostage by three Army deserters who are hiding on the Ponderosa.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Set a Murderer. 1954. Stars Honor Blackman, Martin Boddey, Clifford Evans. Two successful businessmen have a monopoly of the market in their particular field but suddenly a new competitor arrives.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: There's fantastic footage of Johnny Leyton and the wonderful 'Johnny Remember Me'! Noel's found a reel about The Slough Trading Estate and we've got one of the best bread adverts ever made.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1975. Detective & Mystery Drama. The Fall Guy. Stars Alfred Burke, Peter Childs & Ronald Lewis. A girl brings more than beauty into Marker's life when he gets mixed up with the Lord of the Manor.

programme.title: The Executioner
